description: A Java class defining a data model for Android Gradle module dependencies table, including methods for managing dependency items, filtering, and identifying dependency rows.

classes.name: ModuleDependenciesTableModel
classes.description: A table model for managing Android module dependencies, supporting add, remove, edit, filter, and row retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: getItemAt
methods.description: Returns the dependency item at the specified row.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a dependency item to the list.

methods.name: addItemAt
methods.description: Inserts a dependency item at a specific position.

methods.name: removeDataRow
methods.description: Removes and returns the dependency item at the specified row.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Removes a row from the table.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of dependency items.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific row and column.

methods.name: setValueAt
methods.description: Sets the value at a specific row and column.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of a column.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of a column.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Determines if a cell is editable.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the list of dependency items.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Checks if the table has been modified.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the modified status to true.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Provides a filter to include only dependency or non-comment unparseable statements.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Finds the row index of a dependency matching the given GradleCoordinate.
